audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was generic; the lane is a hard losing stretch levels 1-5 and a clean win from 6, which the full layer never said.
audit.why: Packet levelChart gives Naafiri levels 1 through 4-5 and Katarina from 6. Her Q is 9s at rank 1 with 900 range and a second cast on a bleeding target; Katarina has no answer before Death Lotus.
audit.corrected: Concede levels 1-5 to Darkin Daggers and packmate DPS, then take the lane at 6 where one Lotus hits her and the whole pack.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Naafiri timing; breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit at all.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is 110/95/80s, The Call of the Pack is 26/24/22/20/18s, Eviscerate is 11s at rank 1, Darkin Daggers 9s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is the flip; her W is 26s at rank 1 and her R is 110s — both are all-in tickets with long downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was written as 'the lock-on pack dash starts her dive' with no statement of what her kit cannot do to you.
audit.why: Nothing in Naafiri's kit carries hardCC or silence. Her W and E are untargetable windows, not interrupts, so Death Lotus (channel, cancelled only by CC) cannot be broken by her ult. Lotus also hits packmates, which are separate units around her.
audit.corrected: She holds no interrupt — once Lotus starts it finishes; her W and E only make her untargetable for the window, so time the channel after the dash lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability name written as "Hound's Pursuit" in whys[1] and wants.foe[1].
audit.why: Riot's name is Hounds' Pursuit — the apostrophe follows the plural, and the packet flagged it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 12 lint findings: 8 misgendered fields (Naafiri is she/her), 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldowns field with no digit.
audit.why: Deterministic lint output in the brief.

edits.before: A reset duel — your daggers out-sustain his windows, and the first kill in any skirmish turns you into the weather.
edits.after: You lose the duel until 6, then win it forever — Death Lotus hits her and every packmate at once, and she holds no interrupt.

edits.before: Drag the duel into a skirmish and let the resets vote. Every commit starts with one question: is Hounds’ Pursuit down?
edits.after: Survive to 6 with health, not CS, then force the all-in: her R is 110s and her W 26s, and neither one can stop your channel.

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Naafiri wins before 6: Q recast on a bleeding target, packmates adding free damage, and W dodging the Shunpo you answered with.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Kill packmates with a Q bounce first, then trade while Darkin Daggers is on its 9s cooldown — she loses half her damage.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Shunpo forward before 6 with her pack alive — you hand Eviscerate a target and eat the Q recast bleed on the way out.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Naafiri off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.

edits.before: Dagger geometry and patience — chip the no-CC kits, bait the CC ones, and bank patterns for the 6 that changes the lane's species.
edits.after: Concede levels 1-2 outright: her Q recast on a bleeding target plus packmates beats anything you own. Farm the bounce and keep health for 6.

edits.before: First item onward, hunt skirmishes: every 2v2 near your daggers is a reset chain waiting for a signature. Roam when mid stalls.
edits.after: From 6 you take over: bait her W, sidestep the first Q, then E-R — she has no interrupt. Match her R roams or trade them for plates.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: thin and near your side before 6 — packmates die to a Q bounce and she can't dive you off it. Worst wave: a big open wave at level 2-5, which is exactly the all-in she wants. Crash timing: after 6, shove the wave she abandoned when her R leaves for bot.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shunpo (second use) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Hounds' Pursuit (R): 110s at rank 1 — a lock-on dash that grants no CC, so it starts her dive but cannot cancel your Lotus. - The Call of the Pack (W) is 26s at rank 1 and Eviscerate (E) 11s; both are untargetable windows, so wait them out. - Darkin Daggers is 9s.
